bundle.longDescription: Uruk Convert is a clean-room, open-source offline file converter: drag a file onto the sun-disc wheel and turn it into the format you need — images, video, audio and archives — processed entirely on your machine by bundled FFmpeg, ImageMagick and 7-Zip. Second trilogy, first app of the URUK open-source suite.
bundle.shortDescription: Offline file converter with a radial sun-disc wheel
